_doc: Eval boards that are NOT the standard model matrix. The census reads this so arms auditioned elsewhere are not reported as having zero clips -- see eval/build_model_census.py::load_boards. REGISTER, DON'T MERGE: these grids have different axes and their own control arms; folding them onto the standard board destroys the A/B.
